Select exact IC50 measurements for compounds tested against human Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target name 'Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Filter activities by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_relation '='. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
